_comment_perfil: NO `model` KEY, ON PURPOSE (24/09/2026 — repodocs ADR-026). A pin written here cannot win: the account's server-managed settings outrank every local file. And `opus[1m]` was a version pin wearing a window suffix — the 1M variant existed only for the previous Opus, so every session was born on it while the catalog already offered the newer one. To pin a model again, NAME the version: "model": "opus55". The highest effortLevel a FILE accepts is 'xhigh'; use /effort max for a single session.

permissions._comment: Permissoes do projeto - LOOP. Nucleo em Python 3 sem dependencia externa. Allow-list enxuta: git, testes, compilacao e o dry-run do instalador. O install.sh sem --dry-run escreve no ~/.claude/settings.json GLOBAL e por isso fica em ask.

_comment_hooks: Este projeto NAO instala hook proprio no .claude/ local. O produto e um hook Stop GLOBAL, instalado por ./install.sh no ~/.claude/settings.json. Testar o hook alterando o settings.json real e proibido (CLAUDE.md): use CLAUDE_SETTINGS e CLAUDE_SKILLS_DIR apontando para diretorio temporario.
